narrative: On the bookwheel. The upper shelf. A cloth is over the large book, and a grey flank is already on the cloth. Brooke is the thinner book beside it, uncovered, left. The bag is in the room and out of the middle of the frame.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Covered the one book and left the other.
